$$" :question/worked-solution "Let $S$ be an oriented piecewise-smooth surface bounded by a simple, closed, piecewise-smooth boundary $C$ with positive orientation. If a vector field $F$ has continuous partial derivatives for all its components in an open region in space that contains $S,$ then Stokes' theorem states that

$$
{∮}_{C}F\cdot dr={∬}_{S}\text{curl}\,F\cdot \text{d}S.
$$

Along the curve $C,$ we have

$$
x=- \cos{\left(t \right)},\quad y=- 2 \sin{\left(t \right)},\quad z=1
$$

So,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t)) & =\langle - 3 y, 3 x, 0\rangle \\ & =\langle - 3 \left(- 2 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right), 3 \left(- \cos{\left(t \right)}\right), 0\rangle \\ & =\langle 6 \sin{\left(t \right)}, - 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $r\prime(t),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r\prime(t) & =\langle \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(- \cos{\left(t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(- 2 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right), \frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\left(1\right)\rangle \\ & =\langle \sin{\left(t \right)}, - 2 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t) & =\langle 6 \sin{\left(t \right)}, - 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle\cdot \langle \sin{\left(t \right)}, - 2 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 0\rangle \\ & =\left(6 \sin{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(\sin{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(- 3 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(- 2 \cos{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(0\right)\cdot \left(0\right) \\ & =\left(6 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(6 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)}\right)+\left(0\right) \\ & =6 \sin^{2}{\left(t \right)} + 6 \cos^{2}{\left(t \right)} \\ & =6\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate the integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\iint_S\operatorname{curl}F\cdot\mathrm dS & =\oint_C F\cdot\mathrm dr \\ & =\int_{0}^{2 \pi} F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\int_{0}^{2 \pi}\left(6\right)\,\mathrm dt \\ & =\left[\left(6 t\right)\right]_{0}^{2 \pi} \\ & =\left(\left(12 \pi\right)\right)-\left(\left(0\right)\right) \\ & =12 \pi\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["c766976e-6b2f-5d97-a902-e8110fe7515f"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "79ecbd6c-e61f-5ce9-86c4-e7caec648e2e" :answer/id #uuid "79ecbd6c-e61f-5ce9-86c4-e7caec648e2e" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-12" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "f0a3acee-6209-5db5-8d34-42ddc39d0af2" :answer/id #uuid "f0a3acee-6209-5db5-8d34-42ddc39d0af2" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "- 6 \pi" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "935747a9-235d-528c-9945-b1717c8e562a" :answer/id #uuid "935747a9-235d-528c-9945-b1717c8e562a" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "- 12 \pi" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "f27e1353-adf9-5977-b05b-7f5737daaa15" :answer/id #uuid "f27e1353-adf9-5977-b05b-7f5737daaa15" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "0" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "3b3ae743-91b5-55a1-8181-4d006345cf95" :answer/id #uuid "3b3ae743-91b5-55a1-8181-4d006345cf95" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "12 \pi" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c7bac8ec-76be-58f5-9f6a-bfd5a83edd1b" :answer-field/id #uuid "c7bac8ec-76be-58f5-9f6a-bfd5a83edd1b" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["79ecbd6c-e61f-5ce9-86c4-e7caec648e2e" "f0a3acee-6209-5db5-8d34-42ddc39d0af2" "935747a9-235d-528c-9945-b1717c8e562a" "f27e1353-adf9-5977-b05b-7f5737daaa15" "3b3ae743-91b5-55a1-8181-4d006345cf95"] :answer-field/correct "935747a9-235d-528c-9945-b1717c8e562a" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "07a605d5-0ef0-5420-9db8-ccb3e82bd11b" :question/id #uuid "07a605d5-0ef0-5420-9db8-ccb3e82bd11b" :question/problem "Let $S$ be an oriented piecewise-smooth surface bounded by the closed curve $C$ with positive orientation and parametrization $r(t)=\langle 2 \cos{\left(t \right)}, 3 \sin{\left(t \right)}, 1\rangle$ for $t\in [0,2 \pi).$
